scripts.db:generate: if [ -f ../../.env ]; then set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; fi; export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-file:./dev.db}"; prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate: if [ -f ../../.env ]; then set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; fi; export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-file:./dev.db}"; prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma --name init
